info.title: Haya Bila Alam - حياة بلا ألم API
info.description: Complete API reference for all platform modules. Doctor and Patient mobile APIs are grouped by sub-module tags (e.g. Doctor App - Appointments, Patient App - Auth). Send the `Accept-Language` header (`ar` or `en`) on every request for localized messages and catalog text; it is documented on all operations.

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description: Response locale for messages and localized catalog fields. Values: `ar`, `en`. When authenticated, the user's stored preferred language takes precedence over this header.

doctor.description: Doctor profile with speciality and user fields

id.description: User id — pass as userId to verify-otp

PatientAppointmentFilter.description: `finished` is an alias for `completed`. `coming` filters appointments whose datetime is soon.

PatientBookAppointmentRequest.description:
Retrieve doctor availability from GET /patient/doctors/{id}/availability before booking.
Payment is separate — use POST /patient/payments/initiate after booking if needed.

file.description: Single report file (Swagger Try it out). Use field `files` for multiple uploads.

files.description: One or more report files (repeat this part for multiple files).

titles.description: Optional JSON array of titles aligned with uploaded files

certificates.description: Certificate names only — file URLs are admin-only

price.description: Same as fees on detail view

PatientPaymentInitiateRequest.description:
Provide exactly one of appointmentId or homeServiceRequestId.
Payment is separate from booking — appointments can be booked without payment.
Mock provider auto-accepts as PAID; TODO replace with real gateway integration.

delete.summary: Delete a patient medical profile attachment

post.description: Patient app uses 5-digit stub `12345` when OTP provider is mock. Legacy auth uses the same code length.

patch.summary: Update preferred language for the authenticated user
Mark a single notification as read
Update approved amount or partial approval

get.summary: Get reviews for a specific doctor
Get system settings (public filtered by default)

put.summary: Update medical profile (JSON only, structured fields)
put.description: Legacy mirror of Patient App profile update. Use attachment sub-routes for files.

401.description: Invalid credentials, inactive account, or pending admin approval

post.description: Logout and revoke refresh token

post.summary: Create a new lab test request

get.summary: List medical reports for the authenticated doctor
Get support ticket detail with messages

get.description: Returns confirmed appointments only, sorted ascending by date and time.

post.description:
Personal booking endpoint. Retrieve availability from GET /patient/doctors/{id}/availability first.
Payment is separate — booking without payment is allowed.

post.summary: Book online consultation for family member
post.description: Same body as personal booking plus required familyMemberId. List family members via GET /patient/family-members.

200.description: Each item includes doctorName, specializations, datetime, fees, paymentStatus, status, isComing

post.description:
Requires doctor and time slot from availability endpoints.
Home visits use POST /patient/home-services instead.
When paymentMode is INSURANCE, a pre-authorization request is created automatically.
Payment is separate — use POST /patient/payments/initiate after booking if needed.

get.description: Returns doctor data (name, specialization, yearsOfExperience, reviews, address) and appointment data (date, time, price, paymentStatus).

get.summary: Get or join video consultation session

post.description: After registration, call POST /patient/auth/verify-otp with `userId` set to the returned `id`.

post.summary: Patient login with mobile number (PATIENT role only)
post.description: Returns accessToken, refreshToken, and patient profile. Doctor and staff accounts are rejected.

403.description: Account is not authorized for the patient app

post.description:
Use stub code `12345` when OTP provider is mock (until SMS verification is implemented).
On success returns the same shape as login (`accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `patient`).

200.description: OTP verified — same response shape as login

get.description: For profile fields (age, address), prefer GET /patient/profile.

post.description: Logout and revoke refresh token

get.summary: Unified patient bookings (online consultations, home services, clinic services)

200.description: Merged booking list with bookingType, serviceType, and paymentStatus
Records with doctor details (not patient details)
Each doctor includes doctorName, specialization, subSpecializations, totalAppointmentsCount
Available slots and booked windows for selected date

get.description:
Returns name, specialization, subSpecializations, yearsOfExperience, address, reviews,
certificates (names only), and consultationPrice. Certificate file URLs are admin-only.

200.description: Family members with residenceCardNumber, relationship, and derived age

schema.description:
Figma aliases: name → fullName, relationship → relationType.
Age is derived from dateOfBirth when provided.

post.description:
Figma field aliases: bookingType → paymentMode, date → preferredDate,
address → visitAddress, additionalNotes → notes.
List available services via GET /patient/services?type=HOME.

serviceId.description: Must be a HOME type service

200.description: Insurance request with approvals and linked booking

get.summary: List insurance providers (admin-managed catalog for selection)

post.description:
Figma field aliases: insuranceProviderId → providerId, insuranceCardImage → cardImage,
insuranceCreditNumber → policyNumber, insuranceExpiryDate → expiryDate.

get.summary: Download lab test result PDF URL

get.description: Use returned ids when completing medical profile (chronicDiseaseIds).
Use returned ids when completing medical profile (medicationIds / mainMedications).
Use returned ids when completing medical profile (allergyIds).

get.summary: List active medical test types (admin-managed catalog)

200.description: Paginated catalog items (includes localized category when present)

get.summary: Get medical profile (catalog IDs and resolved items)

put.description:
JSON only. Figma aliases: chronicDiseases → chronicDiseaseIds, mainMedications → medicationIds.
Upload medical reports via POST /patient/medical-profile/attachments (Figma — medicalReports).
Manage items individually via chronic-diseases/{id} and medications/{id} sub-routes.

post.summary: Add chronic disease by catalog id
Upload medical report attachments (one or more)

delete.summary: Delete a medical profile report attachment

get.description:
Returns reports, prescriptions, x-rays, and lab tests combined,
ordered by date and time descending.

200.description: Items with recordType, summary, createdAt, uploadedFile

post.description:
Payment methods: VISA, MASTERCARD, APPLE_PAY.
Mock provider auto-accepts as PAID — TODO integrate real payment gateway.
Booking without payment is allowed; initiate payment after booking when ready.
Provide exactly one of appointmentId or homeServiceRequestId.

get.description: Returns name, identity number, phone, age, gender, and address.

patch.description: Alias of PUT — accepts partial fields.

200.description: Full report with clinicalTests, results, attachments

preferredLanguage.description: Maps to language in GET response

get.description: Filter doctors using specializationId (path id).

200.description: Doctors with doctorName, specialization, subSpecializations, totalAppointmentsCount

get.summary: Get support ticket detail with messages
